maddeler.e:
تستصبرون (form X)
# تَسْتَصْبِرُونَ (tastaṣbirūna) /tas.tasˤ.bi.ruː.na/: second-person masculine plural non-past active indicative of اِسْتَصْبَرَ (istaṣbara)
# تُسْتَصْبَرُونَ (tustaṣbarūna) /tus.tasˤ.ba.ruː.na/: second-person masculine plural non-past passive indicative of اِسْتَصْبَرَ (istaṣbara)
maddeler.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
